candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that adds amount to existing betLimit (cumulative update) so AdjustBetAmounts increases instead of setting it.
Replace assignment to betLimit with no-op (remove the assignment) so AdjustBetAmounts only emits the event and does not change betLimit.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that sets betLimit to amount + 1, producing an off-by-one change.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that sets betLimit to amount - 1 (underflow-protected by solidity >=0.8 will revert if amount==0), changing resulting betLimit.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender == owner OR msg.sender == whale, allowing whale to call owner-only functions and thus change betLimit when AdjustBetAmounts is invoked by whale.
